payload.summary: Planning complete after 5 multi-vendor review rounds. The change was split in two: rename-descriptor-model-levels (prerequisite, frees two type names) and derive-descriptors-from-contracts (the feature). Nothing implemented yet. A third branch repairs three review vendors that were silently broken.

decisions.title: Contract is the source; introspection is only the verifier
decisions.rationale: Introspection-as-source fails open: a broken surface yields an empty declared set and a green gate. Verified this is live today — gen-eval's descriptor yields 0 interfaces, so ACA ri-06's coverage gate passes for free.

decisions.title: Extract the rename into its own change
decisions.rationale: Freeing two names and reusing them in one DAG creates a state where a name's meaning depends on which wave ran; verification cannot assert a stable fact about it. Four blocking findings across three rounds all had that shape.

decisions.title: Reclamation is a distinct break from deprecation, and needs its own version bump plus notice
decisions.rationale: A removed name fails loudly; a deprecated name warns; a reclaimed name does neither — the import succeeds and the object is not what it was. Hence CONTRACT_VERSION 1->2 in the rename and 2->3 for the reclamation.

decisions.title: Tool-archetype coverage floor is completeness with declared exclusions, not a percentage
decisions.rationale: 80% is arithmetically unreachable on gen-eval's own CLI (16 flags, 5 exercised = 31.2%). Asserting it would ship a gate that can never pass — the mirror of one that can never fail.

next_steps: Rebase all three branches onto main (cdff1e1e); they are 18-24 commits behind.
Merge openspec/fix-review-vendor-dispatch-config first — independent, and it unblocks future multi-vendor review.
Land openspec/rename-descriptor-model-levels before starting implementation of the feature.
Run the Prerequisites check at the top of tasks.md before Phase 1; it exits non-zero until the rename lands.
Re-run the 27/27 gate audit after any edit to a work-package `command:`.
